notes: Components analyzed via comprehensive grep scan and manual source file verification for window/document/navigator/globalThis usage patterns. All Lit web components render as inert HTML tags in RSC — the import boundary is the critical constraint. Browser APIs in lifecycle hooks (connectedCallback, firstUpdated, updated) and event handlers are safe because these only execute client-side after hydration.

litLabsSsr.notes: @lit-labs/ssr streaming SSR was NOT tested in this audit. Components marked 'ssr-safe' are categorized based on absence of browser APIs in render()/constructor() only.
blockers: hx-format-date: document.documentElement.lang in render() — MUST use explicit lang prop
hx-breadcrumb: document.head.appendChild in updated() — has SSR guard but incompatible with streaming
hx-nav: window.location.href in _sanitizeHref() called from render path — needs guard
hx-drawer: window.matchMedia in _getAnimationDuration() — needs SSR guard

recommendations.title: Always provide lang prop to hx-format-date
recommendations.description: hx-format-date calls document.documentElement.lang in render path. Without explicit lang prop, this would crash with @lit-labs/ssr.

recommendations.title: Document hx-breadcrumb JSON-LD as client-only
recommendations.description: JSON-LD injection into document.head is SSR-guarded but incompatible with streaming SSR. Use framework metadata APIs for SSR SEO.

recommendations.title: Add SSR guard to hx-drawer._getAnimationDuration
recommendations.description: window.matchMedia called without typeof window guard. Safe in practice (only from user-triggered methods) but should be guarded for consistency.

recommendations.title: Add SSR guard to hx-nav._sanitizeHref
recommendations.description: window.location.href used in render path. Safe when rendered as inert RSC tag but would crash with @lit-labs/ssr.
recommendations.action: Add typeof window === 'undefined' guard returning href unchanged

recommendations.title: Evaluate @lit-labs/ssr streaming compatibility
recommendations.description: Full @lit-labs/ssr compatibility testing is a separate effort. Known blockers: hx-format-date, hx-breadcrumb, hx-nav, hx-drawer.
